Malicious Supply-Chain Indicators

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators found.

Automatic Execution Paths

  • repo_context_hooks/platforms/runtime.py contains logic to add Claude hooks into .claude/settings.json for SessionStart, PreCompact, PostCompact, and SessionEnd.

- Examples: python .../repo_specs_memory.py session-start, python .../session_context.py session-start

- However, this appears to be a user-invoked install/initialization feature, not automatic execution during pip install via .pth, sitecustomize.py, setup.py, PEP 517 build hooks, or import-time side effects.

  • install_repo_hooks() copies hook scripts and runs repo_specs_memory.py session-start once, but this is also part of a user-triggered installation flow, not evidence of malicious package-install execution.
  • No malicious install-time automatic execution path was identified in the provided corpus.
  • Possible console_scripts content was not available in the corpus; ordinary console entry points are not treated as malicious automatic execution evidence.

  • Exfiltration/staging: not observed. No evidence of tar/zip/base64 staging, external HTTP upload, webhooks, raw IP C2, or suspicious attacker-controlled endpoints.
  • Telemetry:

- repo_context_hooks/telemetry.py writes local telemetry JSONL files containing repo score, branch name, document presence, and related metadata.

- No external network transmission was identified in the provided code.

  • Persistence:

- The package can add Claude agent hooks to .claude/settings.json, but this appears aligned with the package’s stated hook functionality and is not paired with theft or exfiltration evidence.
